notes: Summary: Relaycroft is a customer-facing KB SaaS provider building an in-product answers widget + support-agent augmentation. Wants hosted API (no private infra) with low latency reranking to serve high QPS bursts. Index profile: ~3–6M passages (articles + ticket snippets) after normalization. Vector dims: 1536 current baseline (sentence-transformer); exploring 768 alternatives for cost trade-offs. Reranking: currently experimenting with a small cross-encoder BERT reranker to improve top-5 precision; worried about CPU/GPU cost at scale. Target SLOs: p95 end-to-end (embed + ANN + rerank) < 150ms for interactive widget, < 80ms for pure rerank step. Peak traffic: baseline 300 QPS, expected growth to 600 QPS peak during business hours (US), occasional spikes to ~1k QPS. Cost sensitivity: tight — target blended cost-per-query <= $0.01; willing to accept small quality trade-offs for cost savings. Wants features: automatic batching, prefix/KV caching for sessions, routing by region (na primary), model pinning for rollouts, per-route dashboards, and token-level cost breakdowns. Security: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs, configurable retention for user content. Comments from product lead: "We need reranker that doesn't blow our margin — show us quantization + caching options." Action items: provide a scaled pricing example (600 QPS) with and without a pointwise reranker, propose fallback policy (smaller reranker or no-rerank) during capacity events. POC notes: the 50k doc POC saw ~12% click-through improvement with hosted cross-encoder rerank but cost estimate scaled poorly.
